Class SoundManager

java.lang.Object
core.SoundManager
public class SoundManager extends Object
A static utility class for managing audio playback in the application.

This manager handles background music and sound effects (SFX), providing independent volume controls (Master, Music, and SFX) and the ability to track, pause, and resume currently playing sounds.

  • Method Details

    • playSFX

      public static void playSFX(String path, double volume)
      Plays a sound effect concurrently.

      A slight random delay (up to 0.16s) is applied before playback. This prevents audio peaking and phasing distortion that occurs when multiple identical sounds are triggered on the exact same frame.

      Parameters:
      path - The internal resource path to the .wav file (excluding "/sounds" and ".wav").
      volume - The base volume multiplier for this specific sound effect.

    • playMusic

      public static void playMusic(String path, double volume)
      Plays looping background music.

      If the requested track is already playing, the request is ignored to prevent restarting the track. Any currently playing music will be stopped first.

      Parameters:
      path - The internal resource path to the .wav file (excluding "/sounds" and ".wav").
      volume - The base volume multiplier for this specific music track.

    • playOnce

      public static void playOnce(String path, double volume)
      Plays a single sound effect using a dedicated player.

      Unlike playSFX(java.lang.String, double), this method interrupts and stops any previously playing sound on this specific player before starting the new one.

      Parameters:
      path - The internal resource path to the .wav file (excluding "/sounds" and ".wav").
      volume - The base volume multiplier for this specific sound effect.
